observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the front of a large framed photovoltaic solar panel with dark cells and white grid lines.
Photo 2 and photo 3 show the rear of the same type of panel: white backing sheet, central junction box, and two black output cables.
A watermark reading NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES appears across all four photos.
A date stamp on all photos reads 2025/08/07 14:54 Lagos, Nigeria.
No brand name, model number, or wattage label is legible on the front or rear of the panel.
The seller sent only text in the reply; no new photo or video was provided.

claims.evidence: Photos show a solar panel, not a battery; no battery is visible.
No battery or charge test is shown in any photo.
Repair history cannot be determined from exterior photos of a panel.

claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true
claims.evidence: Seller's text alone with no supporting photo, video, or test result.

risks.risk: Item mismatch: seller describes a battery but photos show a solar panel
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual item for sale showing whether it is a battery or a panel
risks.if_unproven: as wrong item or not as described

risks.risk: Panel has hidden cracks, hot spots, or delamination not visible in exterior shots
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the cell surface in full sunlight, or an electroluminescence image

risks.risk: Rear junction box or cables are corroded, water-damaged, or loose
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the junction box interior and cable entry seals

risks.risk: Wattage and output are unknown because no specification label is readable
risks.proof: Clear photo of the specification sticker on the rear of the panel

proof_requests: Clear photo of the specification label on the rear of the panel
Close-up photo of the panel surface to check for cracks or damage
Photo showing the actual item if it is a battery rather than a panel
Video of the panel producing output under load or sunlight
response.reason: The photos still show a solar panel, not a battery; the seller's verbal assurance adds no visual evidence, so the item is priced as an untested panel of unknown wattage.
